name: exit-provider
description: Internal Browser Exit provider contract for Runtime-mediated network egress
author: elastos

authority.reason: Defines the internal exit-provider contract behind net-provider without exposing raw sockets, DNS, HTTP clients, or host internet access to app capsules.

interfaces.description: Runtime provider affordance descriptors projected from exit-provider authority metadata; descriptors are not grants.
